raw_prompt: Build a resilient URL shortener with redirects, click analytics, and custom aliases.

requirements.description: Create unique short codes for valid URLs.
Resolve known short codes to their destination URLs.
Record and report aggregate link usage.
Support user-selected short codes subject to collision checks.
Use bounded short-code collision retries and request-size limits; no high-availability guarantee is claimed.

unresolved_questions: What retention period should apply to analytics data?
Are aliases globally unique or scoped to individual users?
What availability target and recovery objective should the service meet?
assumptions: Collect aggregate counts only until a retention policy is approved.
Require globally unique aliases for the initial design.
Validate local failure controls only; do not claim high availability until an SLO and deployment design are approved.
